data.action: 坐在维修工坊操作台边缘，黑白战术服拉链半开，外骨骼装甲整齐卸放在身侧，修长双腿自然悬空晃动，指尖整理耳麦
data.camera: cowboy shot, sitting on workbench, warm volumetric lighting
data.description: 完成高难度潜入任务后的秘密据点内，时坐在坚固的金属维修工作台上。外骨骼机械装甲模块已整齐卸下置于身侧，战术紧身衣前襟拉链解开，微汗的金发侧马尾垂落在白皙肩颈旁。双腿在工作台边自然垂落，蓝宝石般的双眸平静而忠诚地望向刚进门的指挥官。
data.lighting: 工作台吊灯与微蓝应急光
data.promptProse: Toki resting on the edge of a workshop metal workbench after a mission, black and white combat suit unzipped at the front showing bare shoulders and collarbone, mechanical armor neatly detached beside her on the bench, blonde side ponytail, blue eyes, blue halo, dangling slender legs, warm workshop lighting, illuminated monitors.
data.title: 飞鸟马时 · 任务后据点装甲散落
data.animaCaption: She rests on the workbench edge with front zipper lowered beside detached armor.
